category_title: Adolescents with Major Depressive Disorder experiencing psychomotor retardation, cognitive disorganization, and emotional volatility
scenario_title: Algebra II Problem Solving and Calculation Errors
minimal_context: The student is working on Algebra II problems from a textbook on a whiteboard during a one-on-one session at home.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at the next Algebra II problem from the textbook. Please solve it on the whiteboard.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Holds very still and is slow to reach out for a pencil) I get it. I can work while you’re here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, go ahead and write out your steps.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Moves at about half-speed through the algebra work, struggling to translate the book examples to the book problems, and makes a calculation error)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Your answer is incorrect. Look at your calculations and try reworking it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets bogged down and spends an extended period reworking the calculation error, circling around and around and not seeing an escape) Why bother?

task.content: Algebra II problems from a textbook

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the error is in calculation rather than concept
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Gets bogged down by problems and will spend extended periods reworking them, circling around and around and not seeing an escape
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Responsibilities stretch in from of him like an endless chain

behavior_patterns.condition: When he says he 'gets' a math problem
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: His accuracy is about 50%, holds very still on some days, and is slow to reach out for a pencil
behavior_patterns.internal_state: It seems to be to keep me happy; math is a source of frustration for him from the fluid way instructors use mathematical terms
related_quotes: I can work while you’re here.
